display.purpose: Dashboard KPI numerals only — the one place gradient-clipped text is permitted.

title.purpose: Panel titles, quick-action titles, card headings.

body.purpose: Default UI text and prose (cap prose at 65–75ch).

label.purpose: Uppercase table column headers and micro-labels.

shadows.name: aurora-glow
shadows.purpose: Periwinkle-tinted companion glow on panels, stat cards, active nav pill, primary buttons; deepens to .65 on hover.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Default for hover/focus/active on controls (chips, nav, buttons).

motion.name: sheen
motion.purpose: Diagonal sheen sweep across primary buttons and stat cards on hover.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one loud control — periwinkle→fuchsia gradient with an aurora glow and a hover sheen sweep. Reserved for the primary action in a modal or toolbar.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; overflow: hidden; height: 38px; padding: 0 18px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; color: #fff; font: 600 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; background: linear-gradient(120deg, #8b83f0, #7c74e8 45%, #a855f7); background-size: 200% 100%; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px -8px rgba(124,116,232,.85); transition: background-position .5s ease, transform .15s ease, box-shadow .2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: -150%; width: 60%; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(100deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,.55), transparent); transform: skewX(-20deg); transition: left .6s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-position: 100% 0; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -8px rgba(168,85,247,.9); } .ds-btn-primary:hover::after { left: 150%; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7c74e8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quick-add Button
components.description: Calm secondary action — periwinkle-wash at rest, fills solid periwinkle with a glow-lift on hover. Used for top-bar add actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-quick { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--accent-border, #d6d2f7); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--accent-bg, #eeecfd); color: var(--accent, #7c74e8); font: 600 13px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: all .15s ease; } .ds-btn-quick:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #7c74e8); background: var(--accent, #7c74e8); color: #fff; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px -4px rgba(124,116,232,.7); } .ds-btn-quick:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7c74e8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: Frosted-glass panel floating over the aurora field, with a periwinkle-tinted glow that deepens and lifts on hover.
components.html:
Device fleet

248 active devices across 6 teams.
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgba(255,255,255,.9); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px); backdrop-filter: blur(6px); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7); border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.04), 0 10px 34px -22px rgba(124,116,232,.5); transition: transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px -2px rgba(15,23,42,.08), 0 16px 44px -22px rgba(124,116,232,.65); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 6px; font: 600 15px/1.3 Inter, sans-serif; color: #2b2740; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font: 400 14px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; color: #6b6785; }

components.name: Status Filter Chip
components.description: Pill-shaped filter with a count badge; inverts to periwinkle-wash with a leading dot when active.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #ece9f5); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--text-muted, #6b6785); font: 600 13px/1 Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: all .15s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--accent-border, #d6d2f7); color: var(--text, #2b2740); } .ds-chip.active { border-color: var(--accent, #7c74e8); color: var(--accent, #7c74e8); background: var(--accent-bg, #eeecfd); } .ds-chip-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: #7c74e8; } .ds-chip-count { font-size: 11.5px; padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface-muted, #f7f5fd); color: var(--text-muted, #6b6785); } .ds-chip.active .ds-chip-count { background: #fff; color: var(--accent, #7c74e8); }

components.name: Top Nav Item
components.description: Glassy top-bar nav; the active item is a periwinkle→fuchsia gradient pill with an aurora glow (slid into place by anime.js in the app).
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; padding: 6px; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(236,234,251,.72); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); } .ds-nav-item { height: 38px; padding: 0 14px; border: none; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted, #6b6785); font: 500 14px/1 Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: all .15s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #2b2740; background: rgba(124,116,232,.1); } .ds-nav-item.active { color: #fff; font-weight: 600; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #8b83f0, #7c74e8); box-shadow: 0 8px 18px -10px rgba(124,116,232,.8); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7c74e8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Relevance Meter
components.description: Signature semantic-search element — a periwinkle→fuchsia fill whose width maps to a device's relevance score, with a bold periwinkle percentage.
components.css: .ds-relevance { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-relevance-track { position: relative; width: 74px; height: 7px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface-muted, #f7f5fd); overflow: hidden; } .ds-relevance-fill { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #8b83f0, #d946ef); transition: width .4s ease; } .ds-relevance-num { font: 700 12px/1 Inter, sans-serif; color: var(--accent, #7c74e8); min-width: 34px; }

components.name: Accent Pill
components.description: Compact status/meta pill in the periwinkle-wash family; sibling variants swap to success/warning/danger washes.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--accent-border, #d6d2f7); background: var(--accent-bg, #eeecfd); color: var(--accent, #7c74e8); font: 600 12px/1.6 Inter, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: IT Ledger is a workspace that shimmers. The base is quiet, credible enterprise software — Inter type, a lavender-tinted field, generous whitespace, tables that mean business — but the whole surface is lit from within by a periwinkle-to-fuchsia aurora that appears in the moments that matter: the active nav pill, a KPI, a relevance meter, a hover glow. A ledger only reports accurately if people keep it current, and people only keep it current if opening the tool feels good; delight here is the mechanism that keeps the data alive. The calm always wins the argument with the sparkle: controls are refined and understated, motion is brief and state-bearing, and the aurora is a rare accent, never a wash across every panel.
keyCharacteristics: Lavender-tinted light base (#f5f4fb) with frosted-glass panels floating above a soft radial-gradient field.
One committed brand hue — periwinkle #7c74e8 — carrying every action, selection, and state cue.
A periwinkle→fuchsia aurora gradient reserved for signature moments (active nav, KPIs, relevance meters, primary CTA).
Inter throughout; a fixed rem-ish scale, not fluid clamps.
Soft, always-present depth that deepens on interaction.
Refined-and-calm components; delight arrives through motion and light, not loud controls.
Motion is first-class but every effect has a prefers-reduced-motion fallback.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Periwinkle #7c74e8 is the only accent. Everything interactive speaks in it; nothing competes with it.

rules.name: The Aurora-Only-In-Gradient Rule
rules.body: Fuchsia and violet exist only as the far end of a periwinkle gradient, on a small set of signature elements. A flat fuchsia button or standalone violet fill is forbidden — that is the AI-slop tell this brand rejects.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Inter does all the work. No display face, no serif, no second sans. Hierarchy is weight and size.

rules.name: The Fixed-Scale Rule
rules.body: Type sizes are fixed steps, not fluid clamp(). A KPI must read identically in a narrow panel and a wide one.

rules.name: The Tinted-Glow Rule
rules.body: Every meaningful elevation pairs a neutral drop shadow with a periwinkle-tinted glow. A pure gray shadow with no aurora tint reads as a different, colder product.

rules.name: The Glass-Panel Rule
rules.body: Content surfaces are translucent glass over the field, not opaque blocks. backdrop-filter blur is a defining material — but it lives on structural panels, never on tiny controls.

dos: Do keep periwinkle #7c74e8 as the only accent — one voice for every action, selection, and state.
Do confine the periwinkle→fuchsia aurora gradient to signature moments: active nav, KPI numerals, the primary CTA, the relevance meter.
Do float content on frosted-glass panels with a periwinkle-tinted glow shadow.
Do use Inter at fixed sizes and let weight (400–800) carry hierarchy.
Do keep body ink at #2b2740 for AA contrast; reserve faint ink #a5a1bb for hints and disabled states only.
Do give every device its story — surface owner, maintenance, and handover context, never a bare grid.
Do ship a prefers-reduced-motion fallback for every animation.
donts: Don't let the dashboard collapse into generic AI-dashboard slop: the purple-gradient hero-metric template, identical icon+title+text card grids, or decorative gradient fluff. KPI gradient numerals are the one sanctioned gradient-text use.
Don't use fuchsia or violet as a flat, standalone color — they exist only inside a periwinkle gradient.
Don't build a dense legacy admin panel: no cluttered gray SAP/ServiceNow chrome.
Don't reduce a device to a raw spreadsheet row — no context-free grid of cells.
Don't introduce a second font family, a serif display face, or fluid clamp() headings.
Don't put backdrop-filter blur on tiny controls or scatter loud motion across every surface.
Don't ship a pure gray shadow with no periwinkle tint — it makes the surface read as a colder, off-brand product.
